metadata.question: Does the vegetation cover in Robinson Crusoe Island show higher greenness compared to Santa Clara Island in November 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Question: Compare vegetation greenness between Robinson Crusoe Island and Santa Clara Island in November 2018. 2. Strategy: - Use NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) as a measure of greenness - Use Sentinel-2 imagery for good spatial resolution - Time period: November 2018 - Locations: Need to define geometries for both islands - Compare mean NDVI values between the two islands 3. Data Quality Checks: - Check if collections have images for both islands - Check valid pixel counts after cloud masking - Validate NDVI values (should be between -1 and 1) 4. Processing: - Cloud mask Sentinel-2 - Calculate NDVI - Compute mean NDVI for each island - Compare values Let me define the geometries first. Robinson Crusoe Island and Santa Clara Island are part of the Juan Fernández Islands in Chile. - Robinson Crusoe Island: approx (-33.64, -78.85) - Santa Clara Island: approx (-33.70, -78.94) I'll create small buffers around these points to represent the islands. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry Definitions const robinsonCrusoe = ee.Geometry.Point([-78.85, -33.64]).buffer(2000); // 2km buffer const santaClara = ee.Geometry.Point([-78.94, -33.70]).buffer(1500); // 1.5km buffer // 2. Time period const startDate = '2018-11-01'; const endDate = '2018-11-30'; // 3. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 function maskS2Clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } const s2Col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)) .map(maskS2Clouds); // Check collection size const robinsonCol = s2Col.filterBounds(robinsonCrusoe); const santaCol = s2Col.filterBounds(santaClara); const robinsonSize = robinsonCol.size().getInfo(); const santaSize = santaCol.size().getInfo(); print(`Robinson Crusoe Images: ${robinsonSize}`); print(`Santa Clara Images: ${santaSize}`); if (robinsonSize === 0 || santaSize === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // 4. Processing - Calculate NDVI function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } const robinsonMosaic = robinsonCol.map(addNDVI).median().select('NDVI'); const santaMosaic = santaCol.map(addNDVI).median().select('NDVI'); // 5. Calculate statistics and check valid pixels const robinsonStats = robinsonMosaic.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: robinsonCrusoe, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const santaStats = santaMosaic.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: santaClara, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const robinsonMean = robinsonStats.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const robinsonCount = robinsonStats.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); const santaMean = santaStats.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const santaCount = santaStats.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); print(`Robinson NDVI: ${robinsonMean?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${robinsonCount}`); print(`Santa Clara NDVI: ${santaMean?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${santaCount}`); // 6. Validation checks if (robinsonCount === 0 || santaCount === 0) { print("C2"); return; } if (robinsonMean === null || santaMean === null || isNaN(robinsonMean) || isNaN(santaMean) || robinsonMean > 1 || robinsonMean < -1 || santaMean > 1 || santaMean < -1) { print("C3"); return; } // 7. Final comparison if (robinsonMean > santaMean) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
